﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AN — 229AL common-root event collapse and threshold-preserving no-extra-incidence firewall


STATUS: POST_229AM_229AL_EVENT_COLLAPSE_COMPLETE / PROVED_229AL_COMMON_ROOT_GCD_EQUALS_SPACE_ROOT_INERT_PART / PROVED_229AL_COUNT_EVENT_IDENTICAL_TO_229AJ_PACKET_EVENT / PROVED_THRESHOLD_PRESERVATION_HAS_ZERO_EXTRA_LOCAL_INCIDENCE / 229AK_REMAINS_ONLY_CURRENT_FACE_SIGN_ENRICHMENT / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AM SAME-PHYSICAL EVENT-EQUIVALENCE AUDIT / THRESHOLD-PRESERVING ADAPTER COLLAPSE / DEPENDENCE FIREWALL / ROUTE-STATUS REFRESH


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229

CARD_DOC_ID: 1aJL7A5T1VCLe1aWvfETmivTzsQGUEYoNyVIEX9gRwGM


1. Scope


229AL preserved the 229AJ four-packet threshold by writing each inert packet as
  a_tau=gcd_3(s_{a,tau},r_{a,-}r_{a,+}),
  b_tau=gcd_3(s_{b,tau},r_{b,-}r_{b,+}),
where s is one space Euclid root and r_-r_+ is the product of the two face Euclid roots.


The unresolved question is whether this is genuinely a stronger counting event than the original 229AJ packet event. This card proves that it is not: after restricting to inert primes p==3 mod4, the face-product gcd is exactly the inert part of the space root itself. Hence the four 229AL common-root events are pointwise identical to the four 229AJ packet events.


The 229AL identities remain correct. The new result is a routing/firewall refinement: threshold preservation was achieved by aggregating away the face sign, and that aggregation removes all additional local incidence at the event level.


2. Retained root valuations


Retain 229AL notation:
  T_a=(ga,d0c,n1), with face roots r_{a,-},r_{a,+},
  T_b=(gb,d0f,n2), with face roots r_{b,-},r_{b,+}.


For every odd prime p,
  v_p(r_{a,-}r_{a,+})=v_p(ga),
  v_p(r_{b,-}r_{b,+})=v_p(gb).                         (229AN.1)


Retain the space roots from 229AJ/229AL:
  s_{a,-},s_{a,+} from (V,x,R)/c21,
  s_{b,-},s_{b,+} from (U,y,R)/c12.


Because
  V/c21=a(n2/c21),
  U/c12=b(n1/c12),
and every odd prime divisor of n1,n2,c12,c21 is 1 mod4, no inert odd prime outside a occurs in s_{a,-}s_{a,+}, and no inert odd prime outside b occurs in s_{b,-}s_{b,+}.


More precisely, if p^k||a with p==3 mod4, then exactly one a-space root has valuation k and the other has valuation 0. Likewise for p^k||b.


Therefore, writing n_(3) for the p==3 mod4 part,
  (s_{a,tau})_(3)=a_tau,
  (s_{b,tau})_(3)=b_tau.                              (229AN.2)


3. Collapse of the 229AL common-root gcd


Fix tau in {-,+}. Let p==3 mod4.


If p divides s_{a,tau}, then by (229AN.2)
  v_p(s_{a,tau})=v_p(a)=k.
By (229AN.1),
  v_p(r_{a,-}r_{a,+})=v_p(g)+v_p(a)>=k.
Hence
  min(v_p(s_{a,tau}),v_p(r_{a,-}r_{a,+}))=k.


If p does not divide a_tau, then p does not divide s_{a,tau}, so it contributes nothing to the gcd.


Thus
  gcd_3(s_{a,tau},r_{a,-}r_{a,+})
   =(s_{a,tau})_(3)
   =a_tau.                                             (229AN.3)


Similarly,
  gcd_3(s_{b,tau},r_{b,-}r_{b,+})
   =(s_{b,tau})_(3)
   =b_tau.                                             (229AN.4)


RESULT_229AN_229AL_GCD_COLLAPSES_TO_SPACE_ROOT_INERT_PART=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Exact event equivalence with 229AJ


Taking radicals in (229AN.3)-(229AN.4),
  rad(gcd_3(s_{a,tau},r_{a,-}r_{a,+}))=rad_3(s_{a,tau})=A_tau,
  rad(gcd_3(s_{b,tau},r_{b,-}r_{b,+}))=rad_3(s_{b,tau})=B_tau.   (229AN.5)


Therefore for every threshold M and every physical endpoint,
  rad(gcd_3(s_{a,tau},r_{a,-}r_{a,+}))>M
iff
  A_tau>M,
and likewise on the b side.


Consequently the four 229AL counting sets are exactly, point by point, the four 229AJ packet counting sets. Not merely the exponent threshold but the underlying events are identical.


RESULT_229AN_229AL_EVENT_EQUALS_229AJ_EVENT=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AN_THRESHOLD_PRESERVING_FACE_PRODUCT_ADAPTER_ADDS_ZERO_EVENT_LEVEL_FILTER=PROVED_EXACT.


5. Method firewall and route consequence


229AL remains a valid algebraic representation and may still be useful for matching a theorem whose hypotheses are naturally stated in terms of two coupled root variables. But the condition “large common-root gcd” itself is not a new incidence condition: on the physical locus the face product automatically contains every inert prime-power already present in the corresponding space root.


Therefore it is invalid to assign any extra local density, codimension, or gcd-independence saving merely from the 229AL gcd representation.


This sharpens the current route hierarchy:
- 229AJ remains the actual four-packet quantitative receiver at threshold B^(1/12-delta/4).
- 229AL is an EVENT-EQUIVALENT REPARAMETERIZATION of those same four packet events, not an additional face-incidence filter.
- 229AK remains the current sign-resolved interface that genuinely records extra face-root placement, but it pays the eight-packet threshold B^(1/24-delta/8) and its square-divisor conditions are dependent.
- 229AM remains the third-gap redundancy firewall.


No counting promotion follows.


6. Operational consequence


CURRENT_PREFERRED_GATE remains:
  #{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B :
      sf(gcd(eR,xy)) > B^(1/3-delta)}
    = o(B^(1/3))
for some fixed delta>0.

(C) a theorem exploiting 229AK sign-resolved structure strongly enough to compensate the T^(1/8) threshold;
(D) a joint inert/split support theorem with genuine polynomial saving;

- do not multiply 229AK/229AM gap incidences as independent;

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AM — three-gap sign closure and redundant-incidence firewall


STATUS: POST_229AL_SIGN_CLOSURE_COMPLETE / PROVED_229AK_TWO_GAPS_FORCE_THIRD_GAP / PROVED_TRIPLE_SIGN_PRODUCT_CONSTRAINT / PROVED_THIRD_GAP_NOT_INDEPENDENT / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AL SAME-PHYSICAL THREE-GAP CYCLE ADAPTER / SIGN-CLOSURE IDENTITY / DEPENDENCE FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229

1. Scope


229AK proves that every sign-resolved inert packet is simultaneously carried by one primitive face gap and one crossed space gap. A natural next attempt is to add the remaining space triangle and hope for a third independent square-divisibility condition.


This card shows exactly what happens: the third gap is indeed forced with the same packet square, but it is an algebraic linear consequence of the first two congruences. The three signs satisfy one exact parity relation. Therefore triple-gap propagation is genuine structural information but supplies no third independent density factor.


2. Retained physical identities


Retain
  U=b n1,
  x=b d0 c,
  V=a n2,
  y=a d0 f.


Hence the scaled face gaps are exactly
  U+sigma x = b(n1+sigma d0 c),                  (229AM.1)
  V+sigma y = a(n2+sigma d0 f).                  (229AM.2)


Retain229AK: for every sign-resolved a-packet m=a_{sigma,tau},
  m^2 | n1+sigma d0 c,
  m^2 | R+tau x.                                  (229AM.3)
For every b-packet m=b_{sigma,tau},
  m^2 | n2+sigma d0 f,
  m^2 | R+tau y.                                  (229AM.4)


All these packets are odd and supported on p==3 mod4; a- and b-packets are pairwise disjoint as retained from229AK.


3. Exact third-gap propagation for a-packets


Let m=a_{sigma,tau}. From (229AM.1) and (229AM.3),
  m^2 | U+sigma x.
Together with
  m^2 | R+tau x,
take the exact integer linear combination
  (R+tau x) - tau*sigma*(U+sigma x)
    = R - tau*sigma U.                            (229AM.5)


Therefore
  m^2 | R - tau*sigma U.                          (229AM.6)


This is a gap of the other space Pythagorean triangle
  U^2+y^2=R^2.


If lambda is the sign defined by
  m^2 | R+lambda U,
then
  lambda=-sigma*tau,
equivalently
  sigma*tau*lambda=-1.                            (229AM.7)


RESULT_229AM_A_PACKET_THIRD_GAP_PROPAGATION=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AM_A_PACKET_THREE_SIGN_CLOSURE=sigma*tau*lambda=-1.


4. Exact third-gap propagation for b-packets


Let m=b_{sigma,tau}. From (229AM.2) and (229AM.4),
  m^2 | V+sigma y,
  m^2 | R+tau y.


Hence
  (R+tau y) - tau*sigma*(V+sigma y)
    = R - tau*sigma V,
so
  m^2 | R - tau*sigma V.                          (229AM.8)


This is a gap of the other space Pythagorean triangle
  V^2+x^2=R^2.


Writing
  m^2 | R+lambda V,
again
  lambda=-sigma*tau,
so
  sigma*tau*lambda=-1.                            (229AM.9)


RESULT_229AM_B_PACKET_THIRD_GAP_PROPAGATION=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AM_B_PACKET_THREE_SIGN_CLOSURE=sigma*tau*lambda=-1.


5. Three-gap cycle interpretation


Thus every229AK sign-resolved inert packet lies on a closed three-gap cycle.


For an a-packet:
  m^2 | U+sigma x,
  m^2 | R+tau x,
  m^2 | R-sigma*tau U.                            (229AM.10)


For a b-packet:
  m^2 | V+sigma y,
  m^2 | R+tau y,
  m^2 | R-sigma*tau V.                            (229AM.11)


Only two signs are free; the third is forced. The four sign states for each of a and b are therefore equivalently the four triples (sigma,tau,lambda) in {±1}^3 satisfying
  sigma*tau*lambda=-1.


This is compatible with the229E full Pythagorean cycle, but the explicit sign closure and third-gap propagation were not previously registered in the current card index.


RESULT_229AM_THREE_GAP_SIGN_CYCLE=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Redundant-incidence firewall


The third divisibility in (229AM.10) or (229AM.11) is not an additional independent arithmetic event. It is forced by an integer linear combination of the first two divisibilities.


Therefore it is invalid to:
- assign separate local densities to the face gap, first space gap and third gap and multiply all three;
- claim an m^-6 type gain from three square-divisibility conditions;
- treat the third space-root occurrence as a new codimension condition after conditioning on the229AK pair.


At the congruence level, the third condition adds zero independent information once the first two and their signs are fixed.


This sharpens the229AK dependence firewall:
  TWO_GAP_PAIR -> THIRD_GAP EXACTLY,
so any future saving must come from a global same-physical counting theorem using sizes, primitive/coprime structure, cross-prime dispersion, exact R-height, or another non-redundant feature—not from counting a third gap as another independent square condition.


RESULT_229AM_THIRD_GAP_INDEPENDENT_DENSITY=false.
RESULT_229AM_TRIPLE_GAP_MULTIPLICATIVE_SAVING_FIREWALL=PROVED_EXACT.


7. Relation to229AL and current receiver


229AL remains the preferred joint inert theorem interface when a theorem can use one space root against the product of two face roots, because it preserves the229AJ four-packet threshold
  B^(1/12-delta/4).


229AK remains the sign-resolved interface when individual face-root signs are needed, with automatic packet threshold
  B^(1/24-delta/8).


229AM does not create a new receiver threshold. It says that extending229AK from two gaps to the full three-gap cycle does not justify any additional independent density saving.


Thus:

for some fixed delta>0.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AL — threshold-preserving four-packet face-product common-root adapter


STATUS: POST_229AK_THRESHOLD_PRESERVING_COMMON_ROOT_ADAPTER / PROVED_EXACT_FOUR_AGGREGATED_FACE_PRODUCT_GCD_IDENTITIES / PROVED_229AJ_THRESHOLD_PRESERVED_WITH_JOINT_FACE_INFORMATION / 229AK_SIGN_RESOLVED_INTERFACE_RETAINED_SECONDARY / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AK SAME-PHYSICAL ROOT-PRODUCT GCD ADAPTER / INERT FOUR-PACKET THEOREM INTERFACE / THRESHOLD PRESERVATION / DEPENDENCE FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AK
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1w7-VvKGenD2n_5mbQ8rz5pDPdCNCvU-hm6OReM7Z-XY


1. Scope


229AJ packages the whole odd inert part of K_* into four realized space-root packets a_-,a_+,b_-,b_+, and therefore keeps the useful threshold T^(1/4). 229AK adds a second face-root sign by splitting each of those four packets once more, producing eight intersection packets and a T^(1/8) receiver.


The sign-resolved 229AK information is exact, but its finite refinement lowers the automatic packet threshold. This card proves that the face-root information can instead be attached to each original 229AJ packet without splitting it: each 229AJ packet is exactly the inert gcd of one space Euclid root with the product of the two face Euclid roots. Hence the four-packet T^(1/4) threshold is preserved while exposing a genuine same-physical common-root interface.


No counting saving is claimed.


2. Retained roots and notation


Retain
  e=gab,
  x=d0bc,
  y=d0af,
  U=bn1,
  V=an2,
with primitive face triples
  T_a=(ga,d0c,n1),
  T_b=(gb,d0f,n2).


Let r_{a,-},r_{a,+} be the coprime Euclid roots of T_a as in229AK. Their product has the same odd prime-power valuations as ga:
  v_p(r_{a,-}r_{a,+})=v_p(ga) for every odd p.
Likewise
  v_p(r_{b,-}r_{b,+})=v_p(gb).


Let s_{a,-},s_{a,+} be the space Euclid roots from the primitive quotient of (V,x,R) by c21, attached respectively to R-x,R+x, and let s_{b,-},s_{b,+} be the roots from (U,y,R)/c12 attached to R-y,R+y.


For positive integers m,n define
  gcd_3(m,n)=product_{p==3 mod4} p^{min(v_p(m),v_p(n))}.


3. Exact threshold-preserving four common-root identities


By229AJ, every odd inert p^k||a occurs with exponent exactly k in exactly one of s_{a,-},s_{a,+}. No odd inert prime outside a occurs in either space root, because
  V/c21=a(n2/c21)
and every odd prime divisor of n2/c21 is 1 mod4.


If p^k||a is allocated to sign tau, then
  v_p(s_{a,tau})=k.
On the face side,
  v_p(r_{a,-}r_{a,+})=v_p(g)+k >= k.
Therefore
  min(v_p(s_{a,tau}),v_p(r_{a,-}r_{a,+}))=k.
For the opposite space sign the valuation is0.


Thus, with the 229AJ packets,
  a_tau = gcd_3(s_{a,tau}, r_{a,-}r_{a,+})        (229AL.1)
for tau in {-,+}.


The same argument using
  U/c12=b(n1/c12)
and the face roots of T_b gives
  b_tau = gcd_3(s_{b,tau}, r_{b,-}r_{b,+})        (229AL.2)
for tau in {-,+}.


Equivalently, for packet radicals,
  A_tau = rad(gcd_3(s_{a,tau}, r_{a,-}r_{a,+})),
  B_tau = rad(gcd_3(s_{b,tau}, r_{b,-}r_{b,+})).   (229AL.3)


RESULT_229AL_FOUR_AGGREGATED_FACE_PRODUCT_GCD_IDENTITIES=PROVED_EXACT.


These identities retain face-root information without choosing a face-root sign.


4. Threshold-preserving joint receiver


Retain229AJ:
  rad_3(K_*)=A_- A_+ B_- B_+,
with the four factors pairwise coprime.


Combining with (229AL.3),
  rad_3(K_*)
   = product_{tau in {-,+}}
       rad(gcd_3(s_{a,tau},r_{a,-}r_{a,+}))
       rad(gcd_3(s_{b,tau},r_{b,-}r_{b,+})).       (229AL.4)


Hence for every T>=1,
  rad_3(K_*)>T
  =>
  one of the four common-root gcd radicals in (229AL.4) is >T^(1/4).  (229AL.5)


At
  T=B^(1/3-delta),
the threshold remains
  M=B^(1/12-delta/4),                              (229AL.6)
exactly the preferred229AJ threshold, not the smaller229AK threshold B^(1/24-delta/8).


Therefore a sufficient inert-side theorem can be formulated directly as the sum of the four exact same-physical counts
  #{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B:
    rad(gcd_3(s_{a,tau},r_{a,-}r_{a,+}))>M}
and the analogous b-counts being o(B^(1/3)), with M as in (229AL.6).


RESULT_229AL_JOINT_FACE_INFORMATION_WITHOUT_EIGHT_PACKET_THRESHOLD_LOSS=PROVED_EXACT_AS_THEOREM_INTERFACE.


5. Relation to229AK


229AK remains mathematically valid and is not retracted. It resolves which individual face root contains each inert prime and therefore gives the stronger pointwise double-gap statement
  m^2 | one face gap
and
  m^2 | one crossed space gap
for each of eight sign-resolved packets.


229AL changes only theorem routing:

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AK — crossed face-space Euclid-root intersection packetization and dependence firewall

229AJ packages the complete odd inert part of K_* into four clean space-triangle Euclid-root packets carried by R±x and R±y. The remaining quantitative problem is to count those realized packets on the exact physical R-height.


This card adds a second, crossed occurrence of the same inert contents a and b. Each inert prime-power in a or b also lies in a unique Euclid-root factor of one of the primitive face triples. Intersecting the face-root sign with the 229AJ space-root sign partitions the inert support into eight pairwise-coprime same-physical subpackets. Every subpacket is simultaneously a square divisor of one face gap and one space gap.


This is a genuine exact joint-incidence adapter. It is not a counting theorem: the two square-divisibility conditions encode the same a/b content and must not be multiplied as independent local densities.

Retain 229D/229AD/229AJ:
  e=gab,
  x=d0 b c,
  y=d0 a f,
  z=d0 q,
with the primitive face triples
  T_a=(ga,d0 c,n1),
  T_b=(gb,d0 f,n2),
and the space quantities
  U=b n1,
  V=a n2.

  c12=gcd(U,y)=gcd(n1,f),
  c21=gcd(V,x)=gcd(n2,c),
  G_*=gcd(eR,xy)=gcd(UV,xy)=a b c12 c21,
  K_*=sf(G_*).


The six buckets h,d0,a,b,c12,c21 are pairwise coprime. Every odd prime divisor of n1,n2,c12,c21 is 1 mod4. Therefore
  rad_3(K_*)=rad_3(ab),
where rad_3 denotes the radical supported on odd primes p==3 mod4.


3. Face Euclid-root pairs


Apply primitive Pythagorean parameterization to T_a=(ga,d0 c,n1).


There are coprime positive integers r_{a,-},r_{a,+} such that:
- if ga is even,
    n1-d0 c = 2 r_{a,-}^2,
    n1+d0 c = 2 r_{a,+}^2,
    r_{a,-} r_{a,+}=ga/2;
- if ga is odd,
    n1-d0 c = r_{a,-}^2,
    n1+d0 c = r_{a,+}^2,
    r_{a,-} r_{a,+}=ga.


Hence the odd part of r_{a,-}r_{a,+} is the odd part of ga. Since
  y=d0 a f
and 229D gives gcd(g,d0 f)=1,
we obtain the exact odd-part identity
  gcd_odd(r_{a,-}r_{a,+},y)=a_odd.              (229AK.1)


Likewise, applying the same construction to T_b=(gb,d0 f,n2), there are coprime roots r_{b,-},r_{b,+} with
  gcd_odd(r_{b,-}r_{b,+},x)=b_odd.              (229AK.2)


RESULT_229AK_FACE_ROOT_PRODUCTS_RECOVER_ODD_a_b=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Cross with the clean space Euclid roots


For the primitive quotient of (V,x,R) by c21, let s_{a,-},s_{a,+} be the two Euclid roots attached to R-x and R+x. Thus each of R-x,R+x equals c21 times a square or twice c21 times a square, with root s_{a,-} or s_{a,+} respectively.


Because
  V/c21 = a (n2/c21),
and every odd prime divisor of n2/c21 is 1 mod4, every p^k||a with p==3 mod4 occurs with exponent exactly k in exactly one of s_{a,-},s_{a,+}.


Similarly, for the primitive quotient of (U,y,R) by c12, the roots s_{b,-},s_{b,+} attached to R-y,R+y contain each p^k||b, p==3 mod4, with exponent exactly k in exactly one sign.


This recovers the clean 229AJ sign allocation, now with a second face-root sign attached to the same prime-power.


5. Exact eight intersection packets


For sigma,tau in {-,+}, define a_{sigma,tau} as the product of the prime powers p^k||a with p==3 mod4 such that
  p divides r_{a,sigma}
and
  p divides s_{a,tau}.


Define b_{sigma,tau} analogously using r_{b,sigma} and s_{b,tau}.


The face-root pairs are coprime, the space-root pairs are coprime, and gcd(a,b)=1. Therefore all eight packets
  a_{--},a_{-+},a_{+-},a_{++},
  b_{--},b_{-+},b_{+-},b_{++}
are pairwise coprime, and
  a_(3)=product_{sigma,tau} a_{sigma,tau},
  b_(3)=product_{sigma,tau} b_{sigma,tau}.       (229AK.3)


Writing A_{sigma,tau}=rad(a_{sigma,tau}) and B_{sigma,tau}=rad(b_{sigma,tau}),
  rad_3(K_*)

RESULT_229AK_EIGHT_FACE_SPACE_INTERSECTION_PACKETS=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AK_EIGHT_PACKETS_PAIRWISE_COPRIME=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Simultaneous double-gap square divisibility


By construction, if m=a_{sigma,tau}, then m divides both r_{a,sigma} and s_{a,tau}. Since m is odd,
  m^2 | n1 + sigma d0 c,
  m^2 | R + tau x,                               (229AK.5)
with the signs interpreted by the root labels fixed above.


Similarly, if m=b_{sigma,tau},
  m^2 | n2 + sigma d0 f,
  m^2 | R + tau y.                               (229AK.6)


Thus every inert content packet is carried simultaneously by a face Pythagorean gap and a crossed space Pythagorean gap on the same physical endpoint.


RESULT_229AK_SIMULTANEOUS_FACE_SPACE_DOUBLE_GAP_SQUARE_DIVISIBILITY=PROVED_EXACT.


This is stronger structural information than the single-gap realization in 229AJ, but no density gain is assigned yet.


7. Secondary finite receiver and exponent accounting


From (229AK.4), for every T>=1,
  rad_3(K_*)>T
  =>
  max_{sigma,tau}(A_{sigma,tau},B_{sigma,tau}) > T^(1/8).   (229AK.7)


At T=B^(1/3-delta), the corresponding intersection-packet threshold is
  M_joint=B^(1/24-delta/8).                       (229AK.8)


Therefore a sufficient, but not presently proved, joint theorem would be
  sum over the eight packets
    #{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B:
      packet radical > B^(1/24-delta/8)}
  = o(B^(1/3)).                                   (229AK.9)


This is NOT declared preferable to the 229AJ four-packet receiver. The threshold in (229AK.9) is smaller because of the extra finite partition. Its value is that each counted packet satisfies two simultaneous exact physical gap conditions. A future theorem must exploit that joint structure with a genuine gain; otherwise 229AJ remains the sharper interface.


RESULT_229AK_SECONDARY_EIGHT_PACKET_JOINT_RECEIVER=PROVED_EXACT_AS_SUFFICIENT_INTERFACE_ONLY.


8. Dependence firewall


The two divisibilities in (229AK.5) or (229AK.6) are not independent random square-divisor events.


They arise from one and the same content prime-power p^k||a or p^k||b:
- the face occurrence is forced because a divides ga and y, or b divides gb and x;
- the space occurrence is forced because the same a or b is the inert part of V or U, while the companion hypotenuse factors are split-only.


Therefore it is invalid to assign an m^-2 saving to each gap and multiply them into an m^-4 endpoint density without a same-physical theorem proving such decorrelation after conditioning on the full four-Pythagorean cycle and exact R-height.


The correct new theorem interface is a common-root/common-content incidence problem across two coupled primitive Pythagorean triples, not two independent square-divisor sieves.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AJ — dual physical GCD and smooth-inert four-gap packetization


STATUS: POST_229AI_SMOOTH_INERT_PACKETIZATION_COMPLETE / PROVED_DUAL_GSTAR_EQUALS_GCD_UV_xy / PROVED_EXACT_FOUR_GAP_INERT_PACKETIZATION / PROVED_SMOOTH_INERT_RADICAL_FOUR_PACKET_RECEIVER / PROVED_LINEAR_GAP_SQUARE_DIVISOR_NOT_INDEPENDENT / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AI SAME-PHYSICAL SUPPORT ADAPTER / SMOOTH-RADICAL COMPLETION / PYTHAGOREAN GAP PACKETIZATION / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AI
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1tMg7HlpaZjk-fOHFDlZhGhZ4sPV7tgMPzm-_WFhqHEE


1. Scope


229AI isolated the entire odd inert-prime part of the preferred radical:
  rad_3(K_*) = rad_3(ab) = rad_3(UV),
but its prime-only receiver controlled only the single-large-inert-prime subtail. The remaining explicit gap was the smooth inert radical: rad_3(UV) can be large while every individual inert prime is below the large-prime cutoff.


This card completes that structural reduction. It proves two exact facts:
(1) the full physical GCD itself has a dual selector-diagonal form G_*=gcd(UV,xy);
(2) the whole smooth inert radical splits uniquely into four pairwise-coprime packets carried by the four linear physical gaps R±x and R±y.


It then gives a finite four-packet receiver for the smooth inert tail and proves why a generic “large square divisor of a linear gap” sieve is not an independent saving on this physical locus.


No external theorem is used. No endpoint power saving is claimed.


2. Retained exact physical factorization


Retain 229D/229AD/229AI:
  e = g a b,
  x = d0 b c,
  y = d0 a f,
  z = d0 q,
  q^2 = (bc)^2 + (af)^2,
with (bc,af,q) primitive, and
  (ga,d0 c,n1),
  (gb,d0 f,n2)
primitive Pythagorean triples. Hence
  U = b n1,
  V = a n2.


Also retain
  c12 = gcd(U,y) = gcd(n1,f),
  c21 = gcd(V,x) = gcd(n2,c),
and
  G_* = gcd(eR,xy) = a b c12 c21,
  K_* = sf(G_*).


The six buckets h,d0,a,b,c12,c21 are pairwise coprime, and every odd prime dividing c12 or c21 is 1 mod4. Every odd prime dividing n1 or n2 is also 1 mod4 because n1,n2 are primitive Pythagorean hypotenuses.


3. Dual exact physical GCD


From the retained formulas,
  UV = a b n1 n2,
  xy = a b d0^2 c f.


The primitive face triples give
  gcd(n1,d0 c)=1,
  gcd(n2,d0 f)=1.
Also gcd(c,f)=1.


Therefore
  gcd(n1 n2,d0^2 c f)
   = gcd(n1,f) gcd(n2,c)
   = c12 c21.


Consequently
  gcd(UV,xy)
   = a b gcd(n1 n2,d0^2 c f)
   = a b c12 c21
   = G_*.


Thus
  G_* = gcd(eR,xy) = gcd(UV,xy),                 (229AJ.1)
  K_* = sf(gcd(UV,xy)).                          (229AJ.2)


RESULT_229AJ_DUAL_GSTAR_EQUALS_GCD_UV_xy=PROVED_EXACT.


This is an exact same-physical adapter, not a new GCD-height bound. The preferred quotient-free gate remains the 229O form; (229AJ.1) is an additional equivalent physical representation.


4. Exact inert prime-power allocation into four linear gaps


For an integer n, let n_(3) denote the largest divisor of n supported on odd primes p==3 mod4.


Fix an odd inert p==3 mod4 with p^k||b. By229AI, n1 has no inert odd prime factors, so
  v_p(U)=v_p(b)=k.
By the exact factorization of y and the pairwise coprimalities,
  p does not divide y.
By229AI every odd prime divisor of R is split, so
  p does not divide R.


Using
  (R-y)(R+y)=U^2,
we have
  v_p(R-y)+v_p(R+y)=2k.
Moreover
  gcd(R-y,R+y) divides 2R,
and p does not divide 2R. Hence exactly one of R-y and R+y has p-adic valuation 2k, and the other has valuation 0.


Define uniquely
  b_- = product over p^k||b, p==3 mod4, v_p(R-y)=2k of p^k,
  b_+ = product over p^k||b, p==3 mod4, v_p(R+y)=2k of p^k.
Then
  b_(3)=b_- b_+,
  gcd(b_-,b_+)=1,
  b_-^2 | R-y,
  b_+^2 | R+y.                                  (229AJ.3)


The same argument with
  (R-x)(R+x)=V^2
and p^k||a gives unique coprime packets a_-,a_+ such that
  a_(3)=a_- a_+,
  a_-^2 | R-x,
  a_+^2 | R+x.                                  (229AJ.4)


Because gcd(a,b)=1, all four packets
  a_-, a_+, b_-, b_+
are pairwise coprime.


Set
  A_- = rad(a_-), A_+ = rad(a_+),
  B_- = rad(b_-), B_+ = rad(b_+).
Then, using229AI rad_3(K_*)=rad_3(ab),
  rad_3(K_*) = A_- A_+ B_- B_+.                 (229AJ.5)


RESULT_229AJ_INERT_PRIME_POWER_GAP_ALLOCATION=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AJ_FOUR_INERT_PACKETS_PAIRWISE_COPRIME=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AJ_RAD3_KSTAR_FOUR_PACKET_PRODUCT=PROVED_EXACT.


5. Euclid-parameter meaning of the four packets


The space triangle (U,y,R) has content c12. Write
  U=c12 U0, y=c12 y0, R=c12 R0
with (U0,y0,R0) primitive.


If U0 is even, write
  U0=2mn, y0=m^2-n^2, R0=m^2+n^2.
Then
  R-y = 2 c12 n^2,
  R+y = 2 c12 m^2.                               (229AJ.6)


If U0 is odd, write
  U0=m^2-n^2, y0=2mn, R0=m^2+n^2.
Then
  R-y = c12 (m-n)^2,
  R+y = c12 (m+n)^2.                             (229AJ.7)


Thus the b_- and b_+ inert packets are exactly carried by two coprime Euclid square-root components of the physical space triangle, with c12 contributing no odd inert prime.


Likewise, for the primitive quotient of (V,x,R) by its content c21, the a_- and a_+ packets are carried by the two Euclid square-root components of R-x and R+x.


RESULT_229AJ_INERT_PACKETS_ARE_PHYSICAL_EUCLID_ROOT_PACKETS=PROVED_EXACT.


This is consistent with the retained Pythagorean gap-squareclass machinery, but it is the first current adapter that packages the entire smooth inert radical, rather than one inert prime at a time, into finitely many physical root packets.


6. Smooth-inert radical receiver


For any threshold T>=1, (229AJ.5) implies
  rad_3(K_*) > T
  =>
  max(A_-,A_+,B_-,B_+) > T^(1/4).                (229AJ.8)


Therefore, defining the exact same-physical packet counts
  N_{a,-}(B;M)=#{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B : A_->M},
  N_{a,+}(B;M)=#{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B : A_+>M},
  N_{b,-}(B;M)=#{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B : B_->M},
  N_{b,+}(B;M)=#{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B : B_+>M},
we obtain
  #{R<=B endpoints : rad_3(K_*)>T}
   <= N_{a,-}(B;T^(1/4))
    + N_{a,+}(B;T^(1/4))
    + N_{b,-}(B;T^(1/4))
    + N_{b,+}(B;T^(1/4)).                         (229AJ.9)


At the 229AI one-third inert threshold
  T=B^(1/3-delta),
the packet threshold is exactly
  M=B^(1/12-delta/4).                             (229AJ.10)


Hence the entire large-or-smooth inert radical subtail would be closed at o(B^(1/3)) by the single finite receiver
  sum over the four packets N_packet(B; B^(1/12-delta/4))
    = o(B^(1/3)).                                 (229AJ.11)


Unlike the 229AI prime-only sum, (229AJ.11) covers the case in which every inert prime is individually small but their squarefree product is large.

1. Scope


229AH showed that the full simultaneous selector cover Y does not raise the radical center above codimension two. The remaining allowed direction is therefore not another plain codimension computation, but a genuinely arithmetic/global use of the four physical buckets a,b,c12,c21.


This card isolates the entire odd inert-prime part of the current radical K_*=sf(gcd(eR,xy)) and tests whether the corrected three-packet reciprocity of229AG already controls it.


No external theorem is used.


2. Retained exact physical factorization


Retain229D/229AD:
  e = g a b,
  x = d0 b c,
  y = d0 a f,
  z = d0 q,
with
  q^2=(bc)^2+(af)^2
a primitive Pythagorean triple, and
  h=gcd(e,z)=gcd(g,q).


The second square gives the primitive Pythagorean triple
  ((g/h)ab)^2 + (d0(q/h))^2 = (R/h)^2.          (229AI.1)


The two face triples are
  (ga,d0 c,n1),
  (gb,d0 f,n2),
with
  U=b n1,
  V=a n2.                                        (229AI.2)


Retain229AD:
  c12=gcd(U,y)=gcd(n1,f),
  c21=gcd(V,x)=gcd(n2,c),
and
  G_*=gcd(eR,xy)=a b c12 c21,
  K_*=sf(G_*).                                    (229AI.3)


The six buckets h,d0,a,b,c12,c21 are pairwise coprime. Every odd prime dividing h,c12,c21 is 1 mod4.


3. Every odd prime divisor of R is split


In (229AI.1), R/h is the hypotenuse of a primitive Pythagorean triple. Hence every odd prime divisor of R/h is congruent to 1 mod4.


Also h divides q, and q is the hypotenuse of the primitive Pythagorean triple (bc,af,q). Hence every odd prime divisor of h is congruent to 1 mod4.


Therefore
  p odd, p|R  =>  p == 1 mod4.                   (229AI.4)


RESULT_229AI_ODD_R_SUPPORT_SPLIT_ONLY=PROVED_EXACT.


This is a support statement only; it gives no endpoint saving by itself.


4. Exact localization of the inert part of K_*


For a positive integer n define
  rad_3(n)=product of odd primes p|n with p==3 mod4.


Because c12 and c21 have only split odd prime support, (229AI.3) gives
  rad_3(K_*) = rad_3(ab).                         (229AI.5)


By (229AI.2), n1 and n2 are primitive Pythagorean hypotenuses. Thus every odd prime divisor of n1 n2 is 1 mod4. Consequently, for every odd p==3 mod4,
  v_p(U)=v_p(b),
  v_p(V)=v_p(a).                                  (229AI.6)


Hence
  rad_3(K_*) = rad_3(ab) = rad_3(UV).             (229AI.7)


Since gcd(a,b)=1, the inert supports of U and V are disjoint.


RESULT_229AI_INERT_KSTAR_EQUALS_INERT_UV_SUPPORT=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AI_INERT_U_V_SUPPORT_DISJOINT=PROVED_EXACT.


There is also a direct selector-cover formulation. Let p==3 mod4 be odd. On Y,
  U^2=e^2+x^2,
  V^2=e^2+y^2.
Since -1 is nonsquare mod p,
  p|U  iff  p|e and p|x,
  p|V  iff  p|e and p|y.                          (229AI.8)


By (229AI.4), p does not divide R. Therefore, on the physical selector cover,
  p|gcd(eR,xy)
    iff p|U or p|V                                (229AI.9)
for every odd inert p.


Thus the 16 F_p points found by229AH at inert p are exactly the two arithmetic branches U=0 and V=0, equivalently the b- and a-buckets.


RESULT_229AI_INERT_RADICAL_CENTER_EQUALS_UV_ZERO_ON_SELECTOR=PROVED_EXACT.


5. Current229AG reciprocity does not suppress a pure inert singleton


Retain the canonical three-packet notation of229AG:
  Delta0 = 2^tau0 S0 I0,
  Delta+ = 2^tau+ S+ I+,
  Delta- = 2^tau- S- I-,
where Sj is the odd split part and Ij the odd inert part. By229AD,
  I0|d0,
  I+|b,
  I-|a.                                          (229AI.10)


The exact229AG boundary identities are
  (I+/S0)(I0/S+)=(2/S0)^tau+ (2/S+)^(1+tau0),
  (I-/S0)(I0/S-)=(2/S0)^tau- (2/S-)^tau0,
  (I-/S+)(I+/S-)=(2/S+)^(1+tau-) (2/S-)^(1+tau+). (229AI.11)


If S0=S+=S-=1, every Jacobi symbol in (229AI.11) has denominator 1, so all three identities reduce identically to
  1=1.                                            (229AI.12)


Therefore the current three-packet reciprocity identities impose no additional restriction on a support consisting only of inert primes in I+ and/or I-. In particular, a single odd inert prime in b or a is not excluded by229AG. This matches229AH: both a/b branches survive over F_p for every p==3 mod4.


RESULT_229AI_PURE_INERT_SUPPORT_229AG_BOUNDARY_IDENTITIES_TAUTOLOGICAL=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AI_INERT_SINGLETON_NOT_REMOVED_BY_CURRENT_RECIPROCITY=PROVED_EXACT.


This does not assert that arbitrary inert supports are globally realizable. It says only that the current229AG boundary reciprocity supplies no obstruction on this subfamily.


6. Exponent firewall for finite character refinement on the inert-prime tail


Retain229P's method budget. If a squarefree-modulus incidence estimate has the form
  N_m(B) << B^(1+o(1))/m^sigma,
then direct divisor union above Y=B^(1/3-delta) beats B^(1/3) only if
  sigma > 1 + 2/(1-3delta).                       (229AI.13)


In particular sigma=2 gives only
  B^(2/3+delta+o(1)),
and even sigma=3 misses for every fixed delta>0.


For the single-large-prime subtail, the same exponent issue already appears:
  sum_{p>Y, p==3 mod4} B/p^2
  <= sum_{n>Y} B/n^2 << B/Y
  = B^(2/3+delta+o(1)),                           (229AI.14)
by the elementary comparison with all integers.


A fixed residue/Jacobi/mod-8 filter at one prime can change (229AI.14) only by a bounded factor. More generally, any gain obtained solely by imposing O(1)-state character conditions independently per support prime is at most exponential in omega(m), hence m^{-o(1)}, and cannot upgrade an m^{-2+o(1)} incidence estimate to the fixed power m^{-sigma} required by (229AI.13).


For the pure inert singleton branch the conclusion is stronger and exact: Section5 shows the present229AG boundary system contributes no character saving at all.


RESULT_229AI_INERT_PRIME_CODIM2_PLUS_CURRENT_CHARACTER_FILTER_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_ONE_THIRD_BUDGET=PROVED_METHOD_BUDGET.
RESULT_229AI_FINITE_CHARACTER_NO_FIXED_POWER_UPGRADE=PROVED_SCOPED_METHOD_FIREWALL.


This is not an endpoint lower bound and does not rule out a genuinely global large sieve, cross-prime cancellation, bilinear dispersion, support compression, or another theorem whose gain depends on the actual physical distribution rather than a finite local character state.

Define the physical inert-prime incidence
  N_p^inert(B)
   = #{positive primitive physical endpoints R<=B : p|UV},
for odd p==3 mod4. By (229AI.9), this is exactly the inert p-part of the current K_* common-divisor event.

  sum_{p>B^(1/3-delta), p==3 mod4} N_p^inert(B)

The large smooth inert radical remains separate: (229AI.15) alone does not control rad_3(UV)>B^(1/3-delta) when all its prime factors are below the threshold.

(A) a same-physical squarefree-modulus estimate for rad_3(UV) with genuinely stronger-than-codim2 decay;
(B) a direct realized rad_3(UV) support count, including the smooth-radical range;
(C) global cancellation/correlation across the U- and V-branches or between inert and split packets that yields the required o(B^(1/3)) total.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AH — selector-cover codimension-two saturation and radical four-bucket special fiber


STATUS: POST_229AG_SELECTOR_COVER_LOCAL_GEOMETRY_COMPLETE / PROVED_FULL_SELECTOR_COVER_FINITE_OVER_4A1_BASE / PROVED_RADICAL_CENTER_REMAINS_CODIM2 / PROVED_EXACT_32_GEOMETRIC_SPECIAL_POINTS / PROVED_Fp_COUNT_16_OR_32_BY_p_MOD4 / PROVED_FOUR_RADICAL_BUCKET_BRANCH_IDENTIFICATION / SELECTOR_COVER_CODIMENSION_ONLY_SIEVE_HOLD / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AG SAME-PHYSICAL LOCAL GEOMETRY / FULL DOUBLE-COVER RADICAL CENTER / FOUR-BUCKET SPECIAL FIBER / GEOMETRIC-SIEVE FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AG
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1-QtXW18wZVc7uzyhqXOeyu-Nx2UgkJu2wl6cMBfj5YY


1. Scope


229P proved that an ordinary codimension-two modulus density on the fixed physical 4A1 base cannot meet the current one-third radical tail budget through a divisor union. It left open the possibility that lifting to the actual two-square selector cover might raise the effective local codimension.


229F identifies the exact physical base
  X0: x^2+y^2=z^2,
      z^2+e^2=R^2
in P^4, with exact physical height R, and the endpoint locus is obtained by imposing
  U^2=e^2+x^2,
  V^2=e^2+y^2.


This card computes the common-divisor center on that full selector cover. No external theorem is used.


2. Full selector cover remains a surface


Define the projective endpoint selector cover Y in P^6 by
  x^2+y^2=z^2,
  z^2+e^2=R^2,
  U^2=e^2+x^2,
  V^2=e^2+y^2.                                  (229AH.1)


The projection
  pi:Y -> X0,
  [x:y:z:e:R:U:V] -> [x:y:z:e:R]
has finite fibers of size at most four over the algebraic closure, because U and V satisfy two monic quadratic equations over each base point.


Therefore pi is finite set-theoretically on geometric fibers and
  dim Y = dim X0 = 2.                              (229AH.2)


RESULT_229AH_FULL_SELECTOR_COVER_DIMENSION=2_EXACT.


3. Exact radical center on the full selector cover


The current preferred radical is
  K_*=sf(gcd(eR,xy)).
For an odd prime ell, the corresponding mod-ell common-divisor center on Y is
  Z_Y := Y ∩ {eR=0} ∩ {xy=0}.                    (229AH.3)


Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic not two, (229AH.3) splits into four disjoint branches.


(A) e=0, x=0.
Then y^2=z^2, R^2=z^2, U=0, V^2=y^2.
After projective scaling y=1 there are
  z=±1, R=±1, V=±1,
hence exactly 8 geometric points.


(B) e=0, y=0.
Symmetrically, after x=1 there are exactly 8 geometric points.


(C) R=0, x=0.
Then y^2=z^2, e^2=-z^2, U^2=e^2, V=0.
After z=1 there are
  y=±1, e=±i, U=±i,
hence exactly 8 geometric points.


(D) R=0, y=0.
Symmetrically there are exactly 8 geometric points.


The four branches have no projective intersection: e=R=0 forces z=0 and then x=y=0; x=y=0 forces z=0 and then e=R=0. Thus
  #Z_Y(over algebraic closure)=32                   (229AH.4)
as a set of geometric points, in particular Z_Y is zero-dimensional.


Since dim Y=2,
  codim_Y(Z_Y)=2.                                  (229AH.5)


RESULT_229AH_SELECTOR_RADICAL_CENTER_CODIM2=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AH_SELECTOR_RADICAL_CENTER_GEOMETRIC_POINTS=32_EXACT.


4. Exact F_ell point count and split/inert dichotomy


For odd rational ell, branches (A) and (B) are defined over F_ell for every ell and contribute 8 points each.


Branches (C) and (D) require e^2=-z^2 with z nonzero, hence require -1 to be a square mod ell. Therefore
  #Z_Y(F_ell)=16, if ell==3 mod4,
  #Z_Y(F_ell)=32, if ell==1 mod4.                  (229AH.6)


In particular the full selector lift does not make the radical center locally empty at inert primes: the two e=0 branches survive for every odd ell.


RESULT_229AH_RADICAL_CENTER_Fp_COUNT=16_INERT_32_SPLIT_EXACT.


5. The four local branches are exactly the four K_* physical buckets


Retain229D/229AD:
  gcd(e,x)=b,
  gcd(e,y)=a,
and with the endpoint face hypotenuses
  U^2=e^2+x^2,
  V^2=e^2+y^2,
229AD gives
  c12=gcd(U,y),
  c21=gcd(V,x),
together with
  gcd(eR,xy)=a b c12 c21.                          (229AH.7)


For every odd ell:
  ell|e and ell|x  iff ell|b;
  ell|e and ell|y  iff ell|a.                     (229AH.8)


Also
  R^2=U^2+y^2,
  R^2=V^2+x^2.
Hence
  ell|R and ell|y  iff ell|U and ell|y iff ell|c12,
  ell|R and ell|x  iff ell|V and ell|x iff ell|c21. (229AH.9)


Thus the four geometric branches are not an auxiliary decomposition; they are exactly the four physical radical buckets:
  (e=0,x=0) <-> b,
  (e=0,y=0) <-> a,
  (R=0,y=0) <-> c12,
  (R=0,x=0) <-> c21.                              (229AH.10)


The F_ell existence rule in (229AH.6) therefore geometrically recovers229AD:
  a,b are unrestricted at odd primes;
  c12,c21 can contain only ell==1 mod4.
The base-packet buckets h,d0 do not occur in K_*=sf(gcd(eR,xy)), exactly as229AD records.


RESULT_229AH_FOUR_BRANCH_RADICAL_BUCKET_IDENTIFICATION=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AH_SPLIT_BUCKET_GEOMETRY_MATCHES_229AD=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Method consequence: finite selector lifting does not repair the 229P codimension deficit


229P's divisor-union budget requires squarefree-modulus decay stronger than ordinary codimension two; in its notation, sigma=2 is insufficient and even sigma=3 misses the target for positive delta.


The present calculation shows that merely replacing the 4A1 base X0 by the actual simultaneous double-cover Y does not raise the geometric codimension of the common-divisor center:
  codim_X0({eR=xy=0})=2 at the relevant base level,
  codim_Y(Z_Y)=2 exactly.                          (229AH.11)


Moreover Z_Y(F_ell) is nonempty for every odd ell, with the unrestricted a/b branches present even for ell==3 mod4. Therefore no extra prime-support exclusion or third independent local congruence is created solely by passing to the selector cover.


Consequently a standard Ekedahl/geometric-sieve continuation whose entire modulus gain is supplied only by the codimension of the common-divisor center on Y can still certify only the ordinary codimension-two local-density scale, up to harmless ell- or m^{o(1)} factors. 229AF correctly computed the parity of the extra factor 2 contributed by the four Pythagorean gap squareclasses. It then identified those raw gap exponents with the canonical squarefree 2-adic bits of Delta+ and Delta-. That identification is not valid when the physical content bucket a or b is even: the content itself contributes v2(a) or v2(b) to the squareclass.


229E proves only that the even member of {a,b} is divisible by 4 in the G-EVEN and BOTH-ODD types; it does not fix the parity of its 2-adic valuation. Therefore the 229AF sentence
  "the canonical moving twist is even exactly in G-EVEN"
is withdrawn.


This is a scoped correction. The raw gap formulas are retained, and the 229AF residue-matrix firewall survives after replacing the raw exponents by the actual canonical 2-adic bits. No authority, global credit, gate, closure flag, or production status is promoted.


RESULT_229AF_CANONICAL_TWIST_EVEN_IFF_G_EVEN=RETRACTED_SCOPED_BY_229AG.
RESULT_229AF_RAW_GAP_EXPONENT_FORMULAS=RETAINED.
RESULT_229AF_SPLIT_ONLY_MATRIX_FIREWALL=RETAINED_AFTER_CANONICAL_NORMALIZATION.


2. Raw gap exponents versus canonical squarefree bits


Retain 229AD/M notation
  e=gab,
  x=d0 b c,
  y=d0 a f,
  z=d0 q,
  h=gcd(g,q),
with c12,c21 odd by 229AD because they divide primitive Pythagorean hypotenuses.


From 229M's gap lemma,
  [Delta+] = [2^{g_+} b c12],
  g_+ = 1_{ga odd} + 1_{b odd} mod 2,

  [Delta-] = [2^{g_-} a c21],

The canonical squarefree 2-adic bits are therefore
  tau_+ = g_+ + v2(b) mod 2,

For the base packet, 229AD gives
  [Delta0]=[2(R-e)(z-x)].

  [Delta0]=[2^{g_0} h d0],
  g_0 = 1 + 1_{(g/h)ab odd} + 1_{bc odd} mod 2,  (229AG.3)

  tau_0 = g_0 + v2(d0) mod 2.                    (229AG.4)

3. Corrected physical parity router


Write k=v2(the even member of {a,b}); whenever such an even member occurs, 229E gives k>=2 but does not fix k mod2.


G-EVEN:
  d0,c,f are odd; a,b have opposite parity.
If b is odd and a is even with v2(a)=k,
  tau_0=0, (tau_+,tau_-)=(1,k mod2).
If a is odd and b is even with v2(b)=k,
  tau_0=1, (tau_+,tau_-)=(k mod2,1).
Hence the canonical twist bit
  tau_D=tau_++tau_- = 1+k mod2.
So in G-EVEN the canonical twist is even iff k is even.


D-EVEN:
  a,b are odd, d0 is even.
Then
  (tau_+,tau_-)=(0,0),
  tau_D=0,
while
  tau_0 = 1_{c odd}+v2(d0) mod2.
Thus the canonical moving twist is odd in D-EVEN.


BOTH-ODD:
  d0 is odd; a,b have opposite parity.
If b is odd and a is even with v2(a)=k,
  tau_0=0, (tau_+,tau_-)=(1,1+k mod2).
If a is odd and b is even with v2(b)=k,
  tau_0=1, (tau_+,tau_-)=(1+k mod2,1).

  tau_D=k mod2.
So in BOTH-ODD the canonical twist is even iff k is odd.


RESULT_229AG_CORRECTED_CANONICAL_PARITY_ROUTER=PROVED_EXACT.
In particular, the physical parity type alone does not determine the canonical twist parity in G-EVEN or BOTH-ODD.


4. Corrected 229AF Laplacian and survival of the firewall


Let S and I be the odd split and inert prime supports of the moving twist and keep 229AF's split graph Laplacian L_S, inert-boundary vectors mu,beta, and theta_i defined by
  (-1)^{theta_i}=(2/ell_i).

    = (1+tau_+)theta + beta.                     (229AG.5)


The corrected twist-side global reciprocity identity is
  (I_-/S_+)(I_+/S_-)
   = (2/S_+)^{1+tau_-}(2/S_-)^{1+tau_+}.         (229AG.6)

- D-EVEN has (tau_+,tau_-)=(0,0), hence L_S x=theta. The 229AF connected-component obstruction is unchanged: every connected component must contain an even number of primes ell==5 mod8.
- G-EVEN permits canonical pairs among (1,0),(0,1),(1,1). For (1,0), x=0 solves the system; for (0,1), x=1 solves it; for (1,1), x=0 solves L_S x=0.
- BOTH-ODD permits the same three canonical pairs, and the same explicit solutions apply.


Therefore the load-bearing 229AF method conclusion survives:
  residue-matrix solvability alone cannot filter the full physical population.
The correction removes the claimed parity classification, not the firewall.


RESULT_229AG_SPLIT_ONLY_FIREWALL_SURVIVES=PROVED_EXACT.
RESULT_229AF_D_EVEN_COMPONENT_OBSTRUCTION=RETAINED.
RESULT_229AF_G_EVEN_AND_BOTH_ODD_AUTOMATIC_SOLVABILITY=RETAINED_IN_CORRECTED_TAU_FORM.


5. Full three-packet split/inert reciprocity


Now retain the base packet instead of eliminating Delta0. Choose canonical squarefree representatives
  Delta0 = 2^{tau_0} S0 I0,
  Delta+ = 2^{tau_+} S+ I+,
  Delta- = 2^{tau_-} S- I-,                     (229AG.7)
where Sj is the product of odd split primes (1 mod4) in packet j and Ij is the product of odd inert primes (3 mod4). By 229AD the three odd supports are pairwise disjoint, with inert support localized physically as
  I0 | d0,
  I+ | b,

Multiply the exact 229AE character rows over the split primes of the relevant packets and use quadratic reciprocity between split denominators. This gives three exact boundary identities:
  (I+/S0)(I0/S+)
   = (2/S0)^{tau_+}(2/S+)^{1+tau_0},             (229AG.9)


  (I-/S0)(I0/S-)
   = (2/S0)^{tau_-}(2/S-)^{tau_0},               (229AG.10)


  (I-/S+)(I+/S-)
   = (2/S+)^{1+tau_-}(2/S-)^{1+tau_+}.           (229AG.11)


Equation (229AG.11) is the canonically normalized version of the 229AF twist boundary identity. Equations (229AG.9)-(229AG.10) are new base-to-twist boundary identities.

6. Fully split three-packet consequences


Assume I0=I+=I-=1. Put

Then (229AG.9)-(229AG.11) become

Thus the fully split sector satisfies packetwise mod-8/Jacobi restrictions stronger than the twist-product condition alone.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AF — exact Hilbert 2-adic router and split-row reciprocity Laplacian firewall


STATUS: POST_229AE_2ADIC_AND_RECIPROCITY_REFINEMENT / PROVED_EXACT_EPLUS_EMINUS_FROM_PHYSICAL_PARITY_TYPE / PROVED_TWIST_2ADIC_BIT_COMPLETELY_ROUTED / PROVED_SPLIT_INERT_BOUNDARY_RECIPROCITY_IDENTITY / PROVED_SPLIT_ONLY_GRAPH_LAPLACIAN_NORMAL_FORM / PROVED_D_EVEN_COMPONENT_PARITY_OBSTRUCTION / PROVED_G_EVEN_AND_BOTH_ODD_SPLIT_ONLY_RESIDUE_SYSTEM_AUTOMATICALLY_SOLVABLE / RESIDUE_MATRIX_ONLY_SUPPORT_ROUTE_FIREWALL / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / GLOBAL_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AE EXACT 2-ADIC HILBERT BIT ROUTER / QUADRATIC RECIPROCITY COMPRESSION / F2 GRAPH-LAPLACIAN NORMAL FORM / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AE
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1OwaSuOqDdDOEJrwNqv1nti4Y9oCKh2Y8tAuNisInkFk


1. Scope


229AE produced an affine F2 residue system for the twist packet
  D = Delta+ Delta-
but left the two 2-adic packet bits
  e_+, e_- in {0,1}
as input data.


229E already gives an exact physical 2-adic trichotomy for the nested Pythagorean system. Combining229E with the individual gap-squareclass formulas of229M determines e_+,e_- exactly.


This card then rewrites229AE by quadratic reciprocity. On the split-only odd twist sector, the matrix becomes a genuine graph Laplacian over F2. This reveals a sharp method-level fact: the residue system itself can exclude twist values only in the D-EVEN physical parity type. In the G-EVEN and BOTH-ODD split-only types it is automatically solvable for every abstract split-prime twist D.


No claim is made that all such abstract D are physically realized.


2. Retained physical parity trichotomy


Use229D/E notation
  e = g a b,
  x = d0 b c,
  y = d0 a f,
with primitive face triples
  (g a, d0 c, n1),
  (g b, d0 f, n2).


Retain
  c12 | n1,
  c21 | n2.
Because n1,n2 are primitive Pythagorean hypotenuses, n1,n2 are odd. Therefore
  c12,c21 are odd.                               (229AF.1)


The three physical parity types from229E are:


G-EVEN:
  g even, d0,c,f odd, a,b opposite parity.


D-EVEN:
  d0 even, g,a,b odd, c,f opposite parity.


BOTH-ODD:
  g,d0 odd; a,b opposite parity; c,f opposite parity crosswise.


3. Exact individual 2-adic bits of Delta+ and Delta-


Retain229M:
  [Delta+] = [(U-e)(R-U)],
  [Delta-] = [(V-e)(R-V)],                       (229AF.2)
with
  U=b n1,
  V=a n2.


Apply229M.2 separately to the two Pythagorean gaps forming Delta+.


For (e,x,U), the content is b and the first primitive leg is
  e/b = g a.
Hence
  [U-e] = [2^{u1} b],
where
  u1=1 iff g a is odd.                           (229AF.3)


For (U,y,R), the content is c12 and the first primitive leg is
  U/c12 = b(n1/c12).
By (229AF.1), n1/c12 is odd. Hence
  [R-U] = [2^{u2} c12],
where
  u2=1 iff b is odd.                             (229AF.4)


Therefore
  [Delta+] = [2^{e_+} b c12],
  e_+ = 1_{g a odd} + 1_{b odd} mod2.            (229AF.5)


Similarly,
  [V-e] = [2^{v1} a],   v1=1 iff g b odd,
  [R-V] = [2^{v2} c21], v2=1 iff a odd,
so
  [Delta-] = [2^{e_-} a c21],
  e_- = 1_{g b odd} + 1_{a odd} mod2.            (229AF.6)


RESULT_229AF_INDIVIDUAL_HILBERT_2ADIC_BITS=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Evaluate the bits in the three physical parity types


G-EVEN:
g is even, so ga and gb are even. Therefore
  e_+ = 1_{b odd},
  e_- = 1_{a odd}.
Since a,b have opposite parity,
  (e_+,e_-) is either (1,0) or (0,1),            (229AF.7)
and the position of the 2-factor is determined by which of a,b is odd.


D-EVEN:
g,a,b are all odd. Hence
  e_+ = 1+1 =0,
  e_- = 1+1 =0.                                 (229AF.8)


BOTH-ODD:
g is odd and a,b have opposite parity. Hence
  e_+ = 1_{a odd}+1_{b odd}=1,
  e_- = 1_{b odd}+1_{a odd}=1.                  (229AF.9)


Thus the exact router is


  G-EVEN   -> (e_+,e_-) in {(1,0),(0,1)};
  D-EVEN   -> (e_+,e_-)=(0,0);
  BOTH-ODD -> (e_+,e_-)=(1,1).                  (229AF.10)


RESULT_229AF_PHYSICAL_PARITY_TO_PACKET_BITS=PROVED_EXACT.


The total twist 2-adic bit is
  epsilon = e_+ + e_- mod2.
Therefore


  epsilon=1 exactly in G-EVEN,
  epsilon=0 in D-EVEN and BOTH-ODD.              (229AF.11)


Equivalently, the canonical squarefree moving twist of229M/L is even exactly in the G-EVEN physical parity type.


RESULT_229AF_TWIST_2ADIC_BIT_COMPLETELY_ROUTED=PROVED_EXACT.


This removes the formerly unspecified parity bit in229M.5-229M.6.


5. Split/inert decomposition of the229AE system


Write the odd prime support of D as a disjoint union
  S union I,
where
  S={ell: ell|D, ell==1 mod4},
  I={q: q|D, q==3 mod4}.


Let
  S_+, S_-, I_+, I_-
be the products of the primes from S or I assigned respectively to Delta+ and Delta-.


For split vertices ell_i in S, retain229AE
  (-1)^lambda_ij = (ell_j/ell_i),
  (-1)^theta_i   = (2/ell_i).                   (229AF.12)


Let x_i encode the packet color:
  x_i=1 for Delta+,
  x_i=0 for Delta-.


Among split vertices define the F2 graph G_S with an edge i-j iff
  lambda_ij=1.
Quadratic reciprocity gives
  lambda_ij=lambda_ji
for split i,j, because both primes are 1 mod4.


Let L_S be the graph Laplacian over F2:
  (L_S)_{ij}=lambda_ij for i!=j,
  (L_S)_{ii}=sum_{j in S,j!=i} lambda_ij.         (229AF.13)


For each split row put
  mu_i   = sum_{q_j in I} lambda_ij,
  beta_i = sum_{q_j in I} lambda_ij x_j.          (229AF.14)


Then229AE.19 becomes exactly


 [ L_S + diag(mu + (e_+ + e_-) theta) ] x_S
    = (1+e_+) theta + beta                        (229AF.15)


over F2.


RESULT_229AF_SPLIT_INERT_BOUNDARY_LAPLACIAN_FORM=PROVED_EXACT.


The split-split part is therefore symmetric Laplacian data; all inert-prime effects enter only as a diagonal boundary term mu and a forcing vector beta.


6. Global reciprocity boundary identity


Multiply the pure twist residue equations229AE.16 over all split primes in Delta+:
  (Delta-/S_+)=(2/S_+).                          (229AF.16)


Expanding Delta-=2^{e_-} S_- I_- gives
  (S_-/S_+)(I_-/S_+)
    =(2/S_+)^{1+e_-}.                            (229AF.17)


Similarly
  (S_+/S_-)(I_+/S_-)
    =(2/S_-)^{1+e_+}.                            (229AF.18)


All primes of S_+,S_- are 1 mod4, so quadratic reciprocity gives
  (S_-/S_+)=(S_+/S_-).


Multiplying (229AF.17)-(229AF.18) yields the exact global compatibility


  (I_-/S_+) (I_+/S_-)
   =
  (2/S_+)^{1+e_-}
  (2/S_-)^{1+e_+}.                               (229AF.19)


Because the denominators on the left are split, reciprocity also permits
  (I_-/S_+)=(S_+/I_-),
  (I_+/S_-)=(S_-/I_+).                           (229AF.20)


RESULT_229AF_GLOBAL_SPLIT_INERT_RECIPROCITY_IDENTITY=PROVED_EXACT.


This is the row-sum compatibility hidden inside229AE, now expressed directly as a Jacobi-symbol relation between the split and inert packet boundaries.


7. Split-only twist sector


Assume
  I_+=I_-=1.
Then
  mu=beta=0,
and (229AF.15) becomes


  [L_S + (e_+ + e_-) diag(theta)] x
    = (1+e_+) theta.                             (229AF.21)


The global identity becomes
  (2/S_+)^{1+e_-}(2/S_-)^{1+e_+}=1.              (229AF.22)


Now insert the exact physical bit router.


7A. D-EVEN


Here
  (e_+,e_-)=(0,0).
Therefore
  L_S x = theta.                                 (229AF.23)


Because L_S is a symmetric graph Laplacian, the indicator vector of every connected component C of G_S lies in ker L_S. Hence solvability of (229AF.23) forces


  sum_{ell_i in C} theta_i =0 mod2               (229AF.24)


for every connected component C.


Since theta_i=1 exactly when
  ell_i==5 mod8,
every component must contain an even number of 5 mod8 primes.


RESULT_229AF_D_EVEN_SPLIT_ONLY_COMPONENT_PARITY_OBSTRUCTION=PROVED_EXACT.


In particular, globally
  (2/D_odd)=1,                                   (229AF.25)
equivalently the total number of split prime factors ell==5 mod8 is even.


This condition is necessary, not claimed sufficient in general because the F2 Laplacian may have kernel larger than the component-constant subspace.


7B. BOTH-ODD


Here
  (e_+,e_-)=(1,1),
so
  L_S x=0.                                       (229AF.26)


Thus x=0 and x=1 are always solutions of the residue system for every abstract split-prime D.


RESULT_229AF_BOTH_ODD_SPLIT_ONLY_RESIDUE_SYSTEM=AUTOMATICALLY_SOLVABLE.


This means the229AE residue condition alone imposes no twist-support exclusion in this parity type.


7C. G-EVEN


Here e_++e_-=1.


If
  (e_+,e_-)=(1,0),
then
  [L_S+diag(theta)]x=0,                           (229AF.27)
which always has x=0.


If
  (e_+,e_-)=(0,1),
then
  [L_S+diag(theta)]x=theta,                       (229AF.28)
which always has x=1 because L_S 1=0.


Therefore the residue system is again automatically solvable for every abstract split-prime D.


RESULT_229AF_G_EVEN_SPLIT_ONLY_RESIDUE_SYSTEM=AUTOMATICALLY_SOLVABLE.

229AE suggested a possible residue-matrix support count. 229AF shows exactly where that idea can and cannot act.

- G-EVEN: the residue system is automatically solvable for every D;

Therefore a theorem that counts only solvability of the229AE cut system, while forgetting the physical six-bucket realization, cannot by itself be a universal Stage37 twist-support filter. Two of the three physical parity types have an identically nonempty abstract solution set on the split-only sector.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AE — split-prime quadratic-residue cut system for the three-Hilbert packet


STATUS: POST_229AD_LOCAL_RESIDUE_REFINEMENT / PROVED_SPLIT_PRIME_LOCAL_CHARACTER_RULES_FOR_DELTA0_DELTA_PLUS_DELTA_MINUS / PROVED_PURE_TWIST_OPPOSITE_PACKET_CHARACTER_CONDITION / PROVED_AFFINE_REDEI_TYPE_CUT_SYSTEM_ON_SPLIT_PRIME_ROWS / PROVED_INERT_PRIME_ROWS_AUTOMATIC_OVER_QI / STANDARD_Q_MONSKY_BLACKBOX_NOT_IDENTICAL / NO_COUNTING_PROMOTION / PREFERRED_GATE_UNCHANGED / GLOBAL_CREDIT=0 / NO_REOPEN


TYPE: POST-229AD LOCAL 2-DESCENT REFINEMENT / QUADRATIC-RESIDUE CHARACTER PACKET / SPLIT-PRIME CUT MATRIX / METHOD FIREWALL


OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY: M3-T11-229
LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION: M3-T11-228
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA: Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229AD
PRIMARY_GATE: M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
M3_T11_230: NOT ISSUED
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT: 0
CARD_DOC_ID: 1gRwRLFPmPcILZIdQUYcEszvTVQ4AwRuqOJMLQxDWTsM


1. Scope and notation


Retain229L/229AD. Over K=Q(i), every physical selector point has rational squareclasses
  p       = Delta0 c^2,
  p^2+1   = Delta+ a^2,
  p^2-1   = Delta- b^2,                         (229AE.1)
with c,a,b in K^* and Delta0,Delta+,Delta- in Q^*.


Choose positive squarefree rational representatives for the three classes, with their 2-adic bits retained. By229AD their odd supports are pairwise disjoint, and physically
  Delta0 ~ 2^e0 h d0,
  Delta+ ~ 2^e+ b0 c12,
  Delta- ~ 2^e- a0 c21                         (229AE.2)
in Q^*/Q^{*2}, where h,d0,a0,b0,c12,c21 are the six pairwise-coprime physical buckets of229AD.


Put
  D = Delta+ Delta-
as a squareclass. This is the moving congruent-number twist class of229L.


This card extracts the exact odd split-prime local conditions already forced by (229AE.1). No new counting theorem is inserted.


2. Split-prime residue-field lemma


Let ell be an odd rational prime with
  ell == 1 mod 4.
Choose one Gaussian prime pi above ell. Then
  O_K/pi = F_ell.


Let chi_ell be the quadratic character on F_ell^*.


A root i_ell of -1 in F_ell satisfies
  chi_ell(i_ell)
   = i_ell^((ell-1)/2)
   = (-1)^((ell-1)/4)
   = (2/ell),                                    (229AE.3)
where (2/ell) is the ordinary Legendre symbol. Since -1 is itself a square for ell==1 mod4, the two roots +/-i_ell have the same character.


RESULT_229AE_SPLIT_ROOT_CHARACTER=PROVED_EXACT.


3. Local rule at a split prime dividing Delta+


Assume
  ell | Delta+
with ell==1 mod4.


Because Delta+ is squarefree at ell, v_pi(p^2+1) is odd.


If v_pi(p)>0 then p^2+1 is a unit, contradiction.
If v_pi(p)<0 then
  v_pi(p^2+1)=2v_pi(p)
is even, contradiction.
Therefore
  v_pi(p)=0,
  p^2 == -1 mod pi.                              (229AE.4)


From p=Delta0 c^2 and ell not dividing Delta0 by229AD support disjointness,
  (Delta0/ell)=chi_ell(p)=(2/ell).               (229AE.5)


Also
  p^2-1 == -2 mod pi.
Since p^2-1=Delta- b^2 and ell does not divide Delta-,
  (Delta-/ell)=(-2/ell)=(2/ell).                 (229AE.6)


Thus every odd split prime ell in Delta+ satisfies


  (Delta0/ell) = (Delta-/ell) = (2/ell).         (229AE.7)


RESULT_229AE_SPLIT_PRIME_IN_DELTA_PLUS_RULE=PROVED_EXACT.


4. Local rule at a split prime dividing Delta-


Assume
  ell | Delta-
with ell==1 mod4.


The same valuation argument gives
  v_pi(p)=0,
  p^2 == 1 mod pi.                               (229AE.8)


The roots +/-1 are squares in F_ell because -1 is a square. Hence from p=Delta0 c^2,
  (Delta0/ell)=1.                                (229AE.9)


Also
  p^2+1 == 2 mod pi.
Using p^2+1=Delta+ a^2 gives
  (Delta+/ell)=(2/ell).                          (229AE.10)


Therefore every odd split prime ell in Delta- satisfies


  (Delta0/ell)=1,
  (Delta+/ell)=(2/ell).                          (229AE.11)


RESULT_229AE_SPLIT_PRIME_IN_DELTA_MINUS_RULE=PROVED_EXACT.


5. Local rule at a split prime dividing Delta0


Assume
  ell | Delta0
with ell==1 mod4.


Since v_pi(p)=1 mod2, v_pi(p) is nonzero.


Case v_pi(p)>0:
  p^2+1 == 1 mod pi,
  p^2-1 == -1 mod pi.
Because +/-1 are both quadratic residues in F_ell,
  (Delta+/ell)=(Delta-/ell)=1.                  (229AE.12)


Case v_pi(p)<0:
put t=p^{-1}, so v_pi(t)>0. Multiplying the last two equations of (229AE.1) by t^2 gives
  1+t^2 = Delta+ (a t)^2,
  1-t^2 = Delta- (b t)^2.
Reduction mod pi again gives
  (Delta+/ell)=(Delta-/ell)=1.                  (229AE.13)


Thus for every odd split prime ell in Delta0,


  (Delta+/ell)=(Delta-/ell)=1.                  (229AE.14)


RESULT_229AE_SPLIT_PRIME_IN_DELTA0_RULE=PROVED_EXACT.


6. Exact three-color residue packet


Combining Sections3-5, the three pairwise-odd-coprime Hilbert packets satisfy the following complete split-prime character table:


If ell | Delta0 and ell==1 mod4:
  (Delta+/ell)=1,
  (Delta-/ell)=1.


If ell | Delta+ and ell==1 mod4:
  (Delta0/ell)=(2/ell),
  (Delta-/ell)=(2/ell).


If ell | Delta- and ell==1 mod4:
  (Delta0/ell)=1,
  (Delta+/ell)=(2/ell).                          (229AE.15)


Equivalently, at ell==1 mod8 all cross-packet characters appearing above are +1.
At ell==5 mod8, the prescribed (2/ell) entries are -1.


RESULT_229AE_THREE_COLOR_SPLIT_PRIME_CHARACTER_PACKET=PROVED_EXACT.


This strictly sharpens229AD's support-only statement. It records not only where primes may occur but the exact quadratic-residue relation the other packet coefficients must satisfy at each split prime.


7. Pure twist consequence independent of Delta0


The Delta0 entries can be eliminated from part of the system.


For every odd split prime ell dividing Delta+,
  (Delta-/ell)=(2/ell).                          (229AE.16)


For every odd split prime ell dividing Delta-,
  (Delta+/ell)=(2/ell).                          (229AE.17)


Thus every physical factorization
  D = Delta+ Delta-
comes with an exact opposite-packet quadratic-character condition at every split prime of D.


RESULT_229AE_PURE_TWIST_SPLIT_CUT_CONDITION=PROVED_EXACT.


This is a genuine twist-side condition: it no longer mentions the base class Delta0 or the six-bucket realization.


8. Affine split-prime cut matrix


Write the odd part of D as
  D_odd = product_{j=1}^r ell_j
with distinct odd primes.


Let
  x_j in F_2
encode which packet contains ell_j:
  x_j=1 for Delta+,
  x_j=0 for Delta-.


Let
  e_+,e_- in F_2
be the 2-adic exponents of the chosen squarefree representatives Delta+,Delta-.


For each split row ell_i==1 mod4 define
  lambda_ij in F_2 by
    (-1)^lambda_ij = (ell_j/ell_i),  j!=i,
and
  theta_i in F_2 by
    (-1)^theta_i = (2/ell_i).                    (229AE.18)


The opposite packet at ell_i consists exactly of:
- odd primes ell_j with x_j+x_i=1;
- the factor2 with exponent e_- if x_i=1 and exponent e_+ if x_i=0.


Therefore (229AE.16)-(229AE.17) are equivalent to the affine linear equation


  sum_{j!=i} lambda_ij (x_i+x_j)
   + theta_i [ e_- x_i + e_+ (1-x_i) ]
   = theta_i                                  mod2. (229AE.19)


This equation is imposed for every split prime row ell_i|D.
No row is imposed here for ell_i==3 mod4.


For fixed D and fixed 2-adic packet bits, the physically admissible Delta+/Delta- partitions therefore lie in an affine F_2 solution space of an explicit split-row residue matrix.


RESULT_229AE_AFFINE_REDEI_TYPE_SPLIT_CUT_SYSTEM=PROVED_EXACT.


If the resulting matrix has rank rho(D), the number of packet partitions satisfying this necessary condition is at most
  2^(r-rho(D)),                                   (229AE.20)
before imposing the stronger physical six-bucket realization, Delta0 packet, height, and selector conditions.


This is a fixed-D label bound only. It does not count the number of realized D.


9. Why inert rational primes supply no analogous row


Let ell==3 mod4. Then ell is inert in Q(i), and the residue field is
  F_{ell^2}.


Every rational unit in F_ell^* becomes a square in F_{ell^2}^* because
  (ell^2-1)/2
is divisible by ell-1.


Also i is a square in F_{ell^2}: ell^2==1 mod8, so an element of order4 lies in the square subgroup.


Hence the local reductions used in Sections3-5 impose no nontrivial rational Legendre-symbol condition at inert ell.


RESULT_229AE_INERT_PRIME_RESIDUE_ROWS=AUTOMATIC_OVER_QI.


This is consistent with229AD: inert primes of the moving twist may occur only in the unrestricted e-side buckets a0,b0, but their mere presence is not excluded by the Q(i) selector squareclass equations.


10. Relation to Monsky / Redei methods


Equation (229AE.19) is Monsky/Redei-type in shape: an F_2 residue matrix records Legendre-symbol interactions among prime factors and a packet partition.


However it is NOT licensed to identify (229AE.19) with the standard Q-rational Monsky matrix black-box:
- the source point of229L is K=Q(i)-rational;
- inert rational primes have residue degree2 and produce no rows in the present derivation;
- Delta0 is an additional rational Hilbert class outside the moving twist support;
- the Stage37 physical six-bucket and exact R-height realization are extra conditions absent from an ordinary twist-Selmer support count.


A current theorem scan found Monsky-matrix work, including 2026 constructions of congruent/noncongruent-number families, but no theorem directly counting the exact Stage37 realized packet support at o(B^(1/3)). This scan is only a theorem-contract check; no absence theorem is claimed.


RESULT_229AE_STANDARD_Q_MONSKY_BLACKBOX=NOT_IDENTICAL_TO_STAGE37_PACKET.


11. Counting consequence and firewall


229AE gives a new exact local restriction but no global power saving.


Reasons:
- solvability of an affine residue system is a Selmer-type admissibility condition, not by itself a bound on the number of twist values D;
- fixed-D packet-label bounds do not improve229L's already-solved fixed-twist endpoint fiber obstruction;
- 229AC already records that generic 2-Selmer/rank statistics are too broad for the current d<=2B^2 and B^(1/3) budget;
- the exact physical six-bucket realization and exact R-height must remain in any future count.


Therefore
  PHYSICAL_JOINT_RADICAL_GCD_ONE_THIRD = OPEN.
  CM_PAIR_INDEPENDENT_BRANCH = OPEN.
  GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT = 0.


RESULT_229AE_LOCAL_RESIDUE_REFINEMENT_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.


12. Next useful input


The refined theorem targets are now:


(A) PHYSICAL_RESIDUE_MATRIX_SUPPORT_COUNT:
count Stage37 realized twists D for which the split-row system (229AE.19) has a packet solution that ALSO admits the exact229AD six-bucket realization and R<=B, with o(B^(1/3)) output;


(B) THREE_PACKET_CHARACTER_COUNT:
count the full (Delta0,Delta+,Delta-) packet using the exact character table (229AE.15), pairwise odd coprimality, h/c12/c21 split-only support, nested Pythagorean realization, and physical height;


(C) DIRECT_SAME_PHYSICAL_RADICAL_SUPPORT:
the retained preferred gate for sf(gcd(eR,xy));


(D) another selector-aware support theorem meeting the same one-third budget.


DO_NOT_CONTINUE:
- do not count affine packet labels for fixed D as if they were new twist-support savings;
- do not replace the Q(i) split-row system by a standard Q Monsky matrix without an exact adapter;
- do not assign a density saving to Legendre-symbol conditions without a same-physical counting theorem;
- do not reopen generic rank/Selmer distribution scans barred by229AC unless they meet its explicit exponent contract;
- do not reopen CM dependence unless229AB fails audit.


POST_229_REOPEN_TRIGGER_FOUND=false.
M3_T11_230=NOT_ISSUED.

RESEARCH_PRODUCTION_STATUS=HOLD_PENDING_SELECTOR_AWARE_OR_SUPPORT_LEVEL_THEOREM_INPUT.


Integrated audit186-229O remains unchanged in scope and is not silently extended to229P-229AE.

Internal load-bearing inputs:
